faq: Will Android users keep their accounts from iOS?
If your backend holds accounts, yes: the Android app signs in to the same accounts. If accounts exist only inside the iOS app, we plan the data move first, which Standard and Premium cover.
Do iOS subscribers keep access on Android?
A subscription bought on Apple cannot be moved to Google Play. We can honor access by account login where your policy and Google Play rules allow it, and we check those rules before building.
Can you convert Java code to Kotlin automatically?
Tools convert the syntax, but the result needs cleanup to be good Kotlin. We convert in steps, run tests after each step and fix what the converter gets wrong, so the app keeps working.
What do you need to begin?
A working build or the source of the current product, API notes, brand files and your list of must-keep features. Google Play access is only needed at release time, and we never ask for passwords.
